_about: Known short chants (knowledge layer). Used to recognise a chant typed in Devanagari, IAST or casual English spelling and to give it its canonical text, line meanings and source. Translations and sources are drafts for a teacher's review.

chants.name: Om Namaḥ Śivāya
chants.title: Oṃ Namaḥ Śivāya
chants.source: Pañcākṣara mantra; 'namaḥ śivāya' is from the Śrī Rudram (Taittirīya Saṃhitā 4.5.8)

translations.ॐ नमः शिवाय: Om. Salutations to Śiva, the auspicious one.

chants.name: Om Gaṃ Gaṇapataye Namaḥ
chants.title: Oṃ Gaṃ Gaṇapataye Namaḥ
chants.source: Gaṇapati mantra; the seed syllable 'gaṃ' is taught in the Gaṇapati Atharvaśīrṣa

translations.ॐ गं गणपतये नमः: Om. Gaṃ. Salutations to Gaṇapati, lord of the hosts.

chants.name: Hare Kṛṣṇa mahāmantra
chants.title: The Hare Kṛṣṇa Mahāmantra
chants.source: Kali-santaraṇa Upaniṣad (which gives the Hare Rāma half first)
chants.text:
हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे ।
हरे राम हरे राम राम राम हरे हरे ॥

translations.हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण: O Hari, O Kṛṣṇa, O Hari, O Kṛṣṇa,
translations.हरे राम हरे राम: O Hari, O Rāma, O Hari, O Rāma,

aliases: hare krishna hare krishna krishna krishna hare hare hare rama hare rama rama rama hare hare

translations.लोकाः समस्ताः सुखिनो भवन्तु: May all beings everywhere be happy.

chants.name: Oṃ Śāntiḥ
chants.title: Oṃ Śāntiḥ Śāntiḥ Śāntiḥ
chants.source: Closing of the Upaniṣadic śānti mantras
